incident.title: node-ipc supply-chain compromise
incident.detail: The maintainer account 'atiertant' (dormant since 2022) was taken over via an expired email domain. atlantis-software.net expired in January 2025 and was re-registered on 2026-05-07; the attacker set up mail, triggered a password reset, and published three trojaned versions on 2026-05-14 carrying an 80KB credential stealer that exfiltrates via DNS TXT.

narrative.verdict: High risk: atlantis-software.net domain, maintainer 'atiertant', demands immediate investigation due to suspicious re-registration and widespread use.
narrative.narrative: The domain recently re-registered with a new owner, coupled with a massive number of dependents (424) and high weekly downloads (658,012), strongly suggests compromise. The dormant maintainer, 'atiertant', further amplifies the concern, potentially indicating a stolen identity. An attacker could leverage this compromised package to inject malware into numerous systems, exploiting the vulnerable software and its wide distribution.
narrative.recommendation: Immediately contact 'atiertant' (if possible) to verify their identity and control over the 'node-ipc' package; conduct thorough code review and vulnerability scanning.
